metadata.description: Byrd Law Group internal marketplace for Clio Manage tooling.

plugins.name: clio-toolkit
plugins.description: A plaintiff's-PI Clio toolkit: matter analysis, a firm-wide deadline/SOL radar, a stale-matter pulse, new-matter intake and workflow templates, document upload/edit, client text updates, PI demand letters, standard correspondence (LOR/HIPAA/spoliation), and medical bills/liens & special-damages tracking. Bundles clio, clio-matter-analysis, clio-deadline-radar, clio-matter-pulse, clio-mva-new-matter, clio-mva-intake, clio-workflows, clio-documents, clio-client-update, clio-medical-tracker, clio-demand, and clio-letters.
